title: Slow or fast irrigation: a constant water flux
intro: Daisy applies irrigation at a rate in mm/h, so a slow rate keeps the water in the topsoil and a fast one can run off or percolate. The rates below keep the same dose per irrigation, so only the speed of application differs.
